title: Thumbnail for the competition
content:
I would like to ask whether it is acceptable to use a thumbnail featuring garments displayed on a MetaHuman character for the Vivienne Westwood competition.

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Yes, a MetaHuman avatar in the thumbnail is accepted.
Reply 1: 👍🏻Thank You so much! And good luck if You are also participating!!!

Comment 2: Hi, yes of course! Using a MetaHuman avatar is highly encouraged for this contest.
Reply 1: Thanks for your reply! I just had a concern about the main thumbnail. We usually upload a rendered image from CLO or one edited with an AI tool. If I upload the same garment but shown on a MetaHuman as the thumbnail, will that be accepted or could it be rejected?
content_description: This page provides guidance on the acceptability of using thumbnails featuring MetaHuman characters wearing garments for the Vivienne Westwood competition.

title: Skadi: Daughter of the Frozen North
content:
![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202606/d1b537a8d7784f8b99c4da53f869cdf3/images/7c1dcec944eb4ca98a933454e5d80520ChatGPT%20Image%20Jun%2010%2C%202026%2C%2001_32_30%20PM.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202606/d1b537a8d7784f8b99c4da53f869cdf3/images/7693a534470846aab3106590fe6624fanj%3B.png)Skadi – Daughter of the Frozen North

Raised among endless winters and ancient forests, Skadi walks the snow-covered wilderness accompanied by her loyal wolf companion.

This outfit was designed to reflect both resilience and grace, combining Nordic influences, layered fur garments, worn leather details, and tribal accessories.

My focus was creating a character that feels capable of surviving harsh environments while maintaining a memorable silhouette and strong visual presence.

I'd love to hear your thoughts on the costume design, materials, and overall character presentation.  
Technical Notes:

• Clean Quad Topology  
• Optimized UV Layout  
• PBR Texturing in Substance Painter  
• Game-Ready Character Workflow
